verdict.rationale: Viam's docs say every component type exposes a uniform API regardless of brand: cameras share GetImage(), and the same holds for motors, sensors and arms. They also say that changing a camera or motor in config leaves your code working, so hardware can be swapped without rewriting it. Registry drivers and custom driver modules plug into these same interfaces, so new hardware behaves like any built-in component, with the SDKs working automatically. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of real hardware swaps without code changes.
